import re

# Test various patterns
tests = [
    (r'(\d+)(\w+)', '42 hello'),
    (r'(\d{1,})(\w+)', '42 hello'),
    (r'(\d*)(\w+)', '42 hello'),
    (r'(\d+?)(\w+)', '42 hello'),  # non-greedy
]

for pattern, text in tests:
    m = re.match(pattern, text)
    if m:
        print(f'{pattern!r} on {text!r}: groups={m.groups()}')
    else:
        print(f'{pattern!r} on {text!r}: No match')
"
